lines.text: Penny the penguin held her father's flipper tight as they walked to the preschool door!
Her tummy did backflips and she worried, What if nobody wants to play with me?
Inside the classroom, animals were singing songs, stacking blocks, and coloring murals!
Penny stood shyly in the corner until she noticed a bear cub trying to build an igloo!
She took a deep breath, smiled brightly, and said, Hi, my name is Penny! Can I help you?
The cub beamed and handed her a big blue ice block! They laughed and built an arctic fortress!
Making a friend starts with just three magical words: Hi, want to play?
Everyone feels shy sometimes, but a friendly smile opens doors to wonderful friendships!
